messages:
sara: Heads up — since ~13:22 UTC we're seeing a sharp rise in 504/5xx from hosted-api (embeddings + generate). p99 latency and error-rate dashboards spiking. sample request_id: 8f3a1c2b. @mike @julia

mike: looking. any recent rollouts or flag flips?

julia: I pushed a routing selector change to the staged rollout earlier (13:18) to test a routing slice for model-routing v3. It used a namespace selector tweak.

ash: paging oncall (started a PD alert) — high customer impact. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-9876 (severity: high) — notified oncall@sre

support-bot: Customer ticket #3789 opened: "/v1/embeddings returned 504s starting 13:22" — high-volume customer affected.

chris: grabbing a live repro — running curl against hosted endpoint now:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" 
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

chris: response headers show upstream: 504 Gateway Timeout; proxied_from: proxy-abc-5

mike: logs from proxy-abc show repeated: "upstream request timeout waiting for backend" plus 502/504 bursts. Also see rapid connection resets to kvcache-service.

julia: oh — I accidentally broadened the namespace selector (ns:prod-slice) so the staged routing matched the prod slice as well as test. That would route a subset of prod traffic to the new path.

mike: that matches the timing. error rate jump ~13:22 when rollout weight hit ~10%.

sara: we need rollback now. Julia, can you revert the selector and reduce the slice weight to 0?

julia: rolling back the routing selector and scaling weight to 0 — applying config now.
```
# rollback snippet
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: routing-selector
  namespace: infra-config
data:
  ROUTE_SELECTOR: "ns:prod"
EOF
# reduce weight
redwoodctl rollout set-weight model-routing-v3 0
```

mike: I also triggered an emergency deploy to revert the kernel-routing change on the proxy tier: `redwoodctl deploy proxy --image=proxy:stable-2026-03-17`

ash: support notified customer that we're rolling back and investigating.

support-bot: Customer #3789 updated: "Thanks for the quick response — we'll monitor."

julia: rollback applied at 13:26 UTC. Confirming configmaps and rollout weights reverted.

mike: metrics: error-rate peaked ~13:23, started dropping after 13:27. p50/p95 latency trending back toward baseline.

chris: re-tested the curl repro after rollback — got 200 and normal response. request_id: d4b2e9a1.

sara: good. continue monitoring for 15m; if stable we'll close PD and ticket. Also need a short postmortem and a follow-up PR to add a gating check to the selector change.

julia: will open PR and include automated selector unit tests to detect broad-match selectors.

mike: also recommend adding a pre-rollout canary that asserts routing mismatch rate <0.1% for 5m.

ash: thanks everyone. tagging @chris to own the incident write-up and @julia for the config fix PR. :thumbsup:

chris: will draft incident summary and publish to #postmortems. I'll attach timeline, logs, commands used for rollback, and a customer note.

sara: closing loop once stable 15m.
